{{Quote|Having trouble replacing parts on your old Z-95 or Star Duster? We have more parts for more models, new and old, than any other parts dealer in the galaxy.|JR Yakar's e-mail advertisement|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', Email 5130</ref>}}
A '''Star Duster''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it was considered old enough that replacement parts for use in it were in low supply. [[Yakar's Parts]] offered such replacement parts for the Star Duster among its multitude of equipment.
